from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find rect: largest solid uniform block not bg
    best=None
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=I[r][c]
            if v==bg: continue
            h=len([i for i in range(r,H) if I[i][c]==v])
            w=len([j for j in range(c,W) if I[r][j]==v])
            if h*w>(best is None or best[0]*best[1]<h*w): best=(h,w,r,c,v)
    h,w,r0,r1=v=best[0],best[1],best[2],best[3]
    c0=c1=r0+0; 
    # find full extent of the rect color
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==v]
    rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
    rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]==bg or (rr0<=i<=rr1 and cc0<=j<=cc1): continue
            o=O[i][j]
            if rr0>i and cc0<=j<=cc1: o=O[rr0][j]
            elif rr1<i and cc0<=j<=cc1: o=O[rr1][j]
            elif cc0>j and rr0<=i<=rr1: o=O[i][cc0]
            elif cc1<j and rr0<=i<=rr1: o=O[i][cc1]
            else: o=I[i][j]
    return O
